skill.name: turborepo
skill.description: Configure and troubleshoot Turborepo monorepos, including task graphs, caching, filtering, environments, CI, packages, and architectural boundaries.
skill.summary: Practical guidance for reliable, efficient Turborepo monorepos and continuous integration workflows.
skill.author: antfu

security_audit.summary: All 356 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown examples, configuration names, placeholder URLs, and explanatory snippets. The documentation contains no executable scripts, secret collection, data exfiltration, or prompt injection. Normal use may run Turborepo commands, edit repository configuration, and connect to remote caching services at the user's direction.

content.value_statement: Complex task graphs and cache settings can make monorepos slow or unreliable. This skill provides focused Turborepo configuration, debugging, and CI guidance.
actual_capabilities: Reviews task dependencies, outputs, cache settings, and package scripts.
Explains filtering with affected packages, dependency ranges, and directory scopes.
Diagnoses cache misses caused by files, environment variables, and missing outputs.
Guides remote caching, GitHub Actions, Vercel, and general CI optimization.
Recommends package structure, dependency ownership, exports, and architectural boundaries.
Configures development, watch, persistent, interruptible, and transit tasks.
limitations: Guidance targets Turborepo 2.9.19 canary and may not reflect later behavior.
It does not inspect remote cache providers or validate account permissions.
It cannot prove task correctness without repository configuration and package scripts.
Suggested commands may install packages, authenticate services, or change files. Users should review them before execution.

use_cases.title: Configure a New Monorepo
use_cases.description: Define package tasks, dependencies, outputs, and cache inputs for a new Turborepo workspace.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Cache Behavior
use_cases.description: Find missing outputs, undeclared environment inputs, and broad dependencies that cause incorrect or inefficient caching.

use_cases.title: Optimize Continuous Integration
use_cases.description: Run affected packages, configure remote caching, and reduce unnecessary work across continuous integration jobs.

prompt_templates.title: Review Basic Configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my turbo.json and package scripts. Identify missing task dependencies, outputs, and cache settings. Explain each recommended change.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner wants a clear configuration review.

prompt_templates.title: Debug Cache Misses
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these task logs and configuration. Explain why cache misses occur. Check file inputs, environment variables, outputs, and dependency relationships.
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer sees unexpected task execution.

prompt_templates.title: Improve CI Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this CI workflow for a Turborepo repository. Add affected-package execution and remote caching guidance. Preserve required deployment and test dependencies.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team wants faster continuous integration.

prompt_templates.title: Redesign an Advanced Task Graph
prompt_templates.prompt: Redesign this task graph for parallel execution and correct invalidation. Evaluate package configurations, transit tasks, watch mode, environment scope, and architectural boundaries.
prompt_templates.scenario: A platform team is restructuring a large monorepo.

output_examples.input: Review why my build task never restores cached files.
output_examples.output: The review identifies missing build outputs, explains cache restoration, and lists configuration changes by package.

output_examples.input: Make continuous integration run only work affected by this branch.
output_examples.output: The response recommends affected-package execution, explains the comparison base, and preserves dependent package coverage.

output_examples.input: Separate shared environment settings from package-specific settings.
output_examples.output: The response classifies variables by scope, limits credential passthrough, and recommends package-level cache inputs.

best_practices: Provide turbo.json, root package.json, and relevant package scripts for accurate advice.
State the package manager, Turborepo version, CI provider, and expected task outputs.
Review environment passthrough and remote cache settings before applying generated changes.
anti_patterns: Do not place package task logic in root scripts when package-level scripts can own it.
Do not include secret values in prompts. Provide variable names only.
Do not use broad cache inputs or loose environment mode without documenting the tradeoff.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: The skill provides guidance and may suggest Turborepo commands. The active AI tool controls execution and should confirm consequential actions.

faq.question: Can it configure remote caching?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains Vercel and self-hosted remote cache settings, authentication variables, artifact signing, and continuous integration usage.

faq.question: Does it read environment variable values?
faq.answer: No. The documentation names variables and environment files for hashing and passthrough configuration. It contains no code that reads secret values.

faq.question: Which package managers are supported?
faq.answer: The guidance covers common npm, pnpm, Yarn, and Bun workspace patterns when they interact with Turborepo.

faq.question: Which Turborepo version does it target?
faq.answer: The skill declares version 2.9.19-canary.9. Confirm changed features against current Turborepo documentation.

faq.question: Can it replace the official documentation?
faq.answer: No. It provides focused operational guidance. Use official documentation for current releases, provider details, and unsupported edge cases.
